 The implementation follows `EQ-CV-001` through `EQ-CV-005`, `EQ-ORT-001`, and `EQ-MP-001`/`EQ-MP-002`:
 
 ```text

 ## Model structure
 
-- The cardiovascular model is deterministic, beat-averaged, and reduced to four linear-compliance stressed-volume compartments (arterial, central venous, splanchnic venous, lower-limb venous). It has no pulsatile ventricle, dynamic unstressed-volume reservoir, heart chambers, regional denervation state, microcirculation, or venous valves. The pressure-gradient floors are ideal-valve approximations, and central venous stressed volume remains a reduced-order preload proxy, not ventricular end-diastolic volume.
-- Regional gravity pressure offsets lump posture effects per compartment. They are not an angle-specific hydrostatic model, measured splanchnic pooling fluxes, or arterial-side hydrostatic columns; only the shared head-level baroreflex/cerebral correction `G_head` approximates heart-to-head hydrostatics.
-- The skeletal-muscle pump is an explicit computational assumption (frequency, pumped volume, effectiveness, volume half-saturation), not an identified human pump law. The sustained-contraction impediment gain is assumed. Rhythmic activity, sustained contraction, and metabolic exertion are independent inputs; their magnitudes are scenario declarations, not measurements.
-- The baroreflex uses a sigmoidal head-level-pressure target with three first-order effector lags (cardiac sympathetic, vascular sympathetic, vagal). These lags are not pure neural transmission delays; catecholamine concentrations, MSNA, afferent/efferent lesion location, and 0.1 Hz oscillations are not represented. The cardiac-sympathetic/vagal chronotropic gain split is unidentified at fixed total gain—the fixed-total split scenarios change peak but not sustained HR rise—and the default equal split is a calibration choice. Baroreflex findings differ across POTS and JHS/EDS-HT cohorts; no universal gain reduction is justified.
-- The cerebral-flow index is a normalized proxy driven by cerebral perfusion pressure (arterial pressure minus the heart–brain offset and central venous back pressure) through a phenomenological bounded autoregulation curve. It is not measured CBF or MCA velocity, contains no CO2-dependent vasomotion, no intracranial-pressure state, and no vascular territories, so orthostatic hyperventilation effects cannot be inferred from it.
-- The healthy end-tilt cerebral-flow-index reduction is approximately 0.003%, far below the reported approximately 7% control reduction and outside the broad 3–11% soft plausibility band used to disclose that comparison. In the same healthy tilt scenario, heart-level MAP rises by approximately 17.4 mmHg to 117.4 mmHg; pressure-driven autoregulation therefore nearly abolishes the control-side cerebral response. This is a retained warning-level negative result, not evidence that healthy controls have zero orthostatic cerebral-flow change. The ME/CFS 15–35% scenario-band assertion remains unchanged.
-- The healthy early upright cardiac-output reduction is approximately 5.64%, **below** the broad 10–30% literature-derived soft plausibility band. This retained negative result indicates the reduced-order structure underrepresents the early orthostatic CO transient; it is reported as a warning and is not tuned away. The caudal stressed-volume accumulation of approximately 336.55 mL lies inside the broad 300–900 mL soft band.
+- The cardiovascular model is deterministic, beat-averaged, and reduced to five linear-compliance stressed-volume compartments (arterial, central venous, splanchnic venous, lower-limb venous, and one lumped residual other-systemic venous compartment). End-tidal CO2 is an approximate surrogate and is not exact PaCO2; no end-tidal-to-arterial correction is modeled; posture never infers hypocapnia; and the ±15 mmHg clip bounds extrapolation beyond the supported range. Orthostatic hyperventilation effects therefore exist in a run only when a protocol declares them.

+# Stage 1.1 revised architecture and design record
+
+- Model CURIE: `ocpe:disease-models/shared-physiology`
+- Model version: **0.3.0** (Stage 1.1 revision of the Stage 1 model, version 0.2.0)
+- Status: **design record; implementation present in source; deterministic scientific scenario matrix executed** (`validation/stage1-1/scientific-comparison-matrix.md` / `.json`); **release validation executed** at frozen tested source commit `942713ef720ad0e801e71bf9bc78405cd844a739` (full suite 327 passed, 1 skipped, 6 xfailed, 2 warnings in 341.60s; all seven layer execution statuses PASS; overall seven-layer scientific status **FAIL** from the six preserved strict phenotype xfails; strict traceability 0 errors/0 warnings/0 infos; strict OCPE package validation 0 errors/0 warnings)
+
+This document records the Stage 1.1 architecture. It does not replace the
+Stage 1 design gate (`docs/stage1/revised-physiological-architecture.md`) or
+the audited Stage 0 baseline (`docs/stage1/baseline-scientific-report.md`),
+which remain unchanged history. Numerical results quoted from Stage 1 are
+bound to the 0.2.0 tested commit. Executed 0.3.0 scenario results—including
+the negative ones—are recorded in `validation-matrix.md` §§4–6; the executed
+0.3.0 release validation record (commit `942713e`, overall scientific status
+FAIL from the preserved strict phenotype xfails) is summarized in
+`readiness-assessment.md` and `validation-matrix.md`.
+
+## Scope of the revision
+
+Stage 1.1 keeps the Stage 1 structure—conservative stressed-volume
+compartments, three differentiated autonomic effector states, an explicit
+muscle-pump path, a bounded cerebral autoregulation proxy, and the
+phenomenological PEM cascade—and makes six targeted changes:
+
+1. a fifth (residual other-systemic) venous compartment with an explicit
+   25/25/50 baseline flow partition;
+2. hydrostatic posture geometry expressed as heights (cm) times sin(tilt
+   angle) instead of fixed mmHg gravity offsets;
+3. separate aortic and carotid baroreceptor sensors with an integrated
+   weighted baroreflex, distinct from brain-level pressure;
+4. explicit `tilt_angle_deg` protocol posture with linear angle-only
+   transitions;
+5. an explicit per-segment end-tidal CO2 input acting on the cerebral-flow
+   target;
+6. a fixed effective cerebral outflow pressure replacing the central venous
+   back-pressure subtraction.
+
+Everything not listed here—including the bounded pressure-autoregulation
+curve, the preload/contractility stroke-volume equation, the PEM equations,
+the metabolic/extraction equations, and the muscle-pump equations—is
+**retained unchanged** from Stage 1.
+
+## States and volumes (12 states, five volumes)
+
+The state vector now has **12 states**:
+
+| # | State | Unit | Notes |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 | `arterial_volume` | mL | Arterial stressed volume |
+| 2 | `central_venous_volume` | mL | Central venous stressed volume/preload proxy |
+| 3 | `splanchnic_venous_volume` | mL | Splanchnic venous stressed volume |
+| 4 | `lower_limb_venous_volume` | mL | Lower-limb venous stressed volume |
+| 5 | `other_systemic_venous_volume` | mL | **New.** One residual systemic venous compartment lumping all non-splanchnic, non-lower-limb peripheral venous volume |
+| 6 | `cardiac_sympathetic_state` | — | Effector state, initial 0.5 |
+| 7 | `vascular_sympathetic_state` | — | Effector state, initial 0.5 |
+| 8 | `vagal_state` | — | Effector state, initial 0.5 |
+| 9 | `exertional_load` | — | Capacity-normalized load |
+| 10 | `delayed_stress` | — | Delayed exertional stress |
+| 11 | `pem_severity` | — | Normalized phenomenological PEM severity |
+| 12 | `cerebral_flow_index` | — | Normalized cerebral-flow approximation (research proxy) |
+
+The five volume derivatives telescope exactly:
+
+```text
+dVa/dt + dVc/dt + dVs/dt + dVl/dt + dVo/dt = 0
+```
+
+so **exact five-volume conservation** holds analytically, as the four-volume
+identity did in Stage 1. The muscle pump still transfers volume from the
+lower-limb to the central venous compartment without creating blood.
+
+### Baseline flow partition and total stressed volume
+
+Healthy-reference initial stressed volumes are 150 (arterial) + 700 (central
+venous) + 700 (splanchnic venous) + 500 (lower-limb venous) + 500
+(other-systemic venous) = **2550 mL total stressed volume** at
+`blood_volume_factor = 1`.
+
+Regional resistances were re-derived so that the healthy baseline systemic
+flow partitions **25% splanchnic / 25% lower-limb / 50% other-systemic**
+while preserving total cardiac output. Relative to Stage 1 defaults, the
+splanchnic and lower-limb arterial resistances are doubled
+(2.204081632653061 → 4.408163265306122 mmHg·s/mL) and the new
+`other_systemic_arterial_resistance` takes the former value
+(2.204081632653061); venous resistances follow the same pattern
+(0.12244897959183673 → 0.24489795918367346 doubled, other = former value).
+The same transformation was applied to every phenotype that explicitly
+overrode these resistances (POTS hyperadrenergic, hypovolemic, mixed): both
+explicit values were doubled and `other_systemic_*_resistance` was set to the
+original value. Phenotypes that use defaults received no new override. This
+is a re-partition of the same total conductance, not a change in total
+peripheral resistance at the baseline operating point.
+
+## Hydrostatic posture geometry
+
+Fixed mmHg gravity offsets are replaced by heights in centimetres,
+converted with `HYDROSTATIC_MMHG_PER_CM = 0.7356` and scaled by the sine of
+the resolved tilt angle:
+
+```text
+hydrostatic_pressure = 0.7356 × height_cm × sin(tilt_angle)
+```
+
+- `splanchnic_hydrostatic_height_cm` (default 5.43773790103317 = 4.0/0.7356),
+- `lower_limb_hydrostatic_height_cm` (default 10.87547580206634 = 8.0/0.7356),
+- `other_systemic_hydrostatic_height_cm` (default 0.0),
+- `aortic_baroreceptor_height_cm` (default 0.0, heart level),
+- `carotid_baroreceptor_height_cm` (default 25.0),
+- `brain_hydrostatic_height_cm` (default 27.0, replacing the fixed 20 mmHg
+  head offset; 27 cm corresponds to ≈19.9 mmHg at 90 degrees).
+
+Phenotype YAML overrides were migrated with full-precision division
+(`height = offset / 0.7356`). The heights are lumped per-region geometry,
+not measured hydrostatic columns; at 0 degrees every hydrostatic term is
+exactly zero.
+
+## Separate aortic/carotid sensors and the integrated weighted baroreflex
+
+Stage 1 used a single head-level pressure proxy for the baroreflex. Stage
+1.1 separates the two sensor sites from each other and from brain pressure:
+
+```text
+P_aortic  = max(0, Pa - 0.7356 × aortic_baroreceptor_height_cm  × sin(θ))
+P_carotid = max(0, Pa - 0.7356 × carotid_baroreceptor_height_cm × sin(θ))
+aortic_error  = (aortic_setpoint  - P_aortic)  / aortic_scale
+carotid_error = (carotid_setpoint - P_carotid) / carotid_scale
+integrated    = 0.25 × aortic_error + 0.75 × carotid_error   (defaults)
+baroreflex_target = sigmoid(clip(integrated, ±40))
+```
+
+- Aortic and carotid pathways have **independent setpoints and scales**
+  (`aortic_/carotid_baroreflex_pressure_setpoint`,
+  `aortic_/carotid_baroreflex_pressure_scale`). Phenotype overrides of the
+  former single setpoint/scale were duplicated onto both pathways with
+  unchanged values.
+- The integration weights (`aortic_baroreflex_weight = 0.25`,
+  `carotid_baroreflex_weight = 0.75`) are computational assumptions, are
+  validated to sum to 1 within 1e-6, and are not measurements of relative
+  afferent contributions.
+- Brain-level pressure (`brain_hydrostatic_height_cm = 27 cm`) feeds only
+  the cerebral perfusion path; it is **not** a baroreflex sensor. The
+  carotid sinus (25 cm) and brain (27 cm) heights are deliberately distinct
+  parameters.
+
+## Protocol posture and transitions
+
+`ProtocolSegment` now accepts an explicit `tilt_angle_deg` in [0, 90]. The
+legacy normalized `upright` fraction remains accepted and is migrated
+through `tilt_angle_deg = degrees(arcsin(upright))` (so `upright = 1.0` is
+90 degrees); specifying both fields in one segment is an error. During
+`transition_duration` the **angle only** is linearly interpolated from the
+previous segment's angle; all other inputs (exertion, muscle inputs, ETCO2)
+remain piecewise constant. This supports, as registered protocol YAMLs:
+
+- **passive graded tilt**: `passive-tilt-30/45/60/70` and `head-up-tilt`
+  (120 s supine, 30 s passive transition, 480 s at angle);
+- **active standing**: `active-standing` (3 s transition to 90 degrees with
+  ten seconds of declared low-level rhythmic and sustained muscle activity,
+  followed by **sustained quiet standing** to 600 s; activity magnitudes are
+  protocol assumptions, not a calibrated gait model);
+- **tilt-back**: `tilt-recovery` now includes a 30 s linear tilt-back to
+  supine and a 600 s supine recovery window;
+- **cerebral CO2 isolation protocols**: `pressure-reduction`,
+  `co2-reduction`, `combined-pressure-co2-reduction`,
+  `pressure-recovery-persistent-hypocapnia`, and
+  `co2-recovery-persistent-pressure-reduction` under `simulations/cerebral/`.
+
+## Segment end-tidal CO2 and cerebral CO2 reactivity
+
+Each segment may declare `end_tidal_co2_mmHg`; `None` selects the model
+reference `end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg = 40.0`. The cerebral-flow target is
+multiplied by
+
+```text
+cerebral_co2_factor = exp(0.035 × clip(ETCO2 - 40, -15, +15))
+```
+
+where 0.035/mmHg is `cerebral_co2_reactivity_per_mmHg` and ±15 mmHg is
+`cerebral_co2_extrapolation_limit_mmHg`. Consequences, stated deliberately:
+
+- **No posture-inferred hypocapnia.** Tilt does not change ETCO2;
+  orthostatic hypocapnia exists in a run only when a protocol segment
+  declares it. Upright segments that omit ETCO2 stay at the 40 mmHg
+  reference.
+- **ETCO2 is not exact PaCO2.** End-tidal CO2 is an approximate, biased
+  surrogate of arterial PCO2 (including under orthostasis); the model
+  consumes the declared end-tidal value directly and makes no
+  ETCO2→PaCO2 correction.
+- The ±15 mmHg clip bounds extrapolation of the exponential reactivity
+  outside the evidence-supported range; the clip also enters the declared
+  cerebral-flow-index upper bound used by the runtime guards.
+
+## Fixed effective cerebral outflow pressure
+
+Cerebral perfusion pressure is now
+
+```text
+CPP = max(0, brain_arterial_pressure - 5.0 mmHg)
+```
+
+with `cerebral_outflow_pressure_mmHg = 5.0` a **fixed effective downstream
+pressure**. It is explicitly **neither thoracic central venous pressure nor
+a separately resolved intracranial pressure**: the Stage 1 subtraction of
+the central-venous compartment pressure is removed, and no ICP state is
+introduced. The bounded pressure-autoregulation curve
+(`ratio / (slope + (1 - slope) × ratio)` about
+`cerebral_reference_perfusion_pressure = 95 mmHg`,
+`cerebral_autoregulation_residual_slope = 0.2`) and the asymmetric
+decline/recovery first-order cerebral-flow-index dynamics are **retained
+unchanged**. The cerebral-flow index (CFI) remains a **normalized research
+proxy**—not measured CBF, MCA velocity, or a Doppler reconstruction.
+
+## Retained equations (unchanged by Stage 1.1)
+
+- Preload/contractility stroke volume:
+  `SV = stroke_volume_max × contractility × Vc / (Vc + stroke_volume_half_volume)`
+  with the sympathetic contractility term and its lower bound.
+- Bounded cerebral pressure-autoregulation curve (above).
+- Chronotropic HR assembly (rest + cardiac-sympathetic + vagal + exertion,
+  clipped to [30, 220] bpm), including the unidentified
+  cardiac-sympathetic/vagal gain split at fixed total gain.
+- Muscle-pump transfer and sustained-contraction venous impediment.
+- Metabolic capacity, oxygen extraction, and functional-capacity constructs.
+- Phenomenological exertional-load / delayed-stress / PEM cascade.
+
+## Parameter classification
+
+Stage 1.1 adds parameters in both registry provenance classes, and the
+distinction is part of the design:
+
+- **Literature-anchored (group-level, scenario-grade):** the 40 mmHg ETCO2
+  reference and the approximately 0.035/mmHg cerebral CO2-reactivity
+  magnitude are consistent with published cerebral vasomotor CO2-reactivity
+  ranges; the 25/25/50 regional flow partition is consistent with published
+  group-level regional flow distributions. These anchor *scenarios*, not
+  patients.
+- **Computational operating points / calibration assumptions:** the 0.25/0.75
+  aortic/carotid weights, the 0 and 25 cm sensor heights, the 27 cm brain
+  height, the fixed 5 mmHg effective cerebral outflow pressure, the ±15 mmHg
+  CO2 extrapolation limit, the 0 cm other-systemic hydrostatic height, and
+  all doubled/halved resistance re-partitions. None of these is a direct
+  clinical measurement.
+
+Supported ranges remain deterministic sensitivity/scenario ranges, not
+confidence intervals or population distributions.
+
+## Explicit non-scope
+
+Stage 1.1 contains **no synthetic wearable dataset, no synthetic patient
+cohort, no TSFM or other machine-learning component, and no Stage 2 or
+Stage 3 work**. The deterministic seed remains metadata; no random numbers
+are consumed. Registry, declarative-package, and validation-record
+synchronization for the 0.3.0 revision is **complete** (strict traceability
+audit 0 errors/0 warnings/0 infos; strict OCPE validation 0 errors/0
+warnings); readiness is assessed in `readiness-assessment.md`.

+## 4. Key unresolved scientific limitations
+
+1. **Preserved Stage 1 misses, re-measured at 0.3.0** (details in
+   `validation-matrix.md` §§4–5): the healthy CO/SV orthostatic miss

+   non-lower-limb venous volume is one compartment with a 0 cm hydrostatic
+   height; this is a modeling closure, not anatomy.

+# Stage 1.1 scientific decision log
+
+Each entry records the decision, rationale, considered alternative, and
+status. "Implemented" means present in source. The deterministic scientific
+scenario comparison matrix has been executed for 0.3.0
+(`validation/stage1-1/scientific-comparison-matrix.md` / `.json`), and the
+release validation cycle (test suite, traceability, OCPE package validation,
+fixtures, sensitivity, demonstrations) has been executed at frozen tested
+commit `942713ef720ad0e801e71bf9bc78405cd844a739` — full suite 327 passed,
+1 skipped, 6 xfailed, 2 warnings in 341.60s; all seven layer execution
+statuses PASS; overall seven-layer scientific status FAIL from the preserved
+strict phenotype xfails (see `validation-matrix.md`).
+
+## D1.1-01 — Add one residual other-systemic venous compartment
+
+- **Decision.** Split the systemic circulation into splanchnic, lower-limb,
+  and one lumped residual (`other_systemic_venous_volume`) venous path, with
+  matching arterial resistances. Five volume states, twelve states total.
+- **Rationale.** The Stage 1 two-region peripheral split forced 50/50
+  baseline flow between splanchnic and lower-limb beds, which
+  under-represents the rest of the systemic circulation. A single residual
+  compartment is the smallest change that admits a literature-consistent
+  **25/25/50 baseline flow partition** while keeping exact volume
+  conservation (five derivatives telescope to zero) and a **2550 mL** total
+  healthy stressed volume.
+- **Alternative rejected.** Adding further named regional beds (renal,
+  cerebral, cutaneous, muscle sub-compartments): not identifiable from
+  current evidence and would multiply assumed parameters.
+- **Status.** Implemented; scenario-matrix baselines are consistent
+  (healthy baseline CO 81.667 mL/s, MAP 100 mmHg); fixed-point and
+  conservation evidence executed in the mathematical layer (45 passed,
+  exact five-volume telescoping and exact supine fixed points of all ten
+  configurations).
+
+## D1.1-02 — Re-partition resistances at fixed total conductance
+
+- **Decision.** Double splanchnic and lower-limb arterial resistances
+  (defaults and explicit phenotype overrides) and set
+  `other_systemic_arterial_resistance` to the original value; same pattern
+  for venous resistances. Phenotypes without explicit resistance overrides
+  (including neuropathic POTS, hEDS, ME/CFS, Long COVID) received none.
+- **Rationale.** At the shared baseline pressures this leaves total systemic
+  conductance and cardiac output unchanged while producing the 25/25/50
+  partition; the transformation is exact arithmetic, not recalibration.
+- **Alternative rejected.** Refitting resistances per phenotype from flow
+  data: no patient-level regional flow data justify it.
+- **Status.** Implemented in defaults and in the three POTS YAMLs with
+  explicit resistance overrides; executed in the scenario matrix.
+
+## D1.1-03 — Hydrostatic heights and explicit tilt angle
+
+- **Decision.** Replace per-region gravity pressure offsets (mmHg) with
+  heights (cm) converted at 0.7356 mmHg/cm and scaled by sin(tilt angle).
+  Defaults migrated exactly (`4.0/0.7356`, `8.0/0.7356`); phenotype offsets
+  migrated with full-precision division. Posture is declared as
+  `tilt_angle_deg` in [0, 90]; the legacy `upright` fraction maps through
+  `degrees(arcsin(upright))`; declaring both is an error. Transitions
+  linearly interpolate the **angle only** over `transition_duration`.
+- **Rationale.** The Stage 1 fixed offsets could not represent graded tilt
+  (30/45/60/70 degrees), active standing, or tilt-back; sin(θ) scaling is
+  the standard hydrostatic geometry and makes the supine limit exactly zero.
+- **Alternative rejected.** Instantaneous (step) posture changes: retained
+  only when `transition_duration = 0`; a nonzero passive-transition time
+  (30 s tilt, 3 s active stand) is the more faithful scenario.
+- **Status.** Implemented and executed in the scenario matrix: graded
+  healthy sustained HR rises of 3.626/5.417/6.954/7.723 bpm at 30/45/60/70
+  degrees, active-standing 8.383 bpm, inactive-standing 8.383 bpm;
+  `head-up-tilt` and `passive-tilt-70` produce equivalent reported metrics
+  under their declared solver sample grids. Simulation-registry
+  synchronization is complete (19 protocols, 11 simulation records).
+
+## D1.1-04 — Separate aortic and carotid sensors; integrated weighted baroreflex
+
+- **Decision.** Model aortic (heart level, 0 cm) and carotid (25 cm)
+  baroreceptor pressures separately, each with its own setpoint and scale,
+  and integrate one weighted error (defaults 0.25 aortic / 0.75 carotid,
+  sum-to-1 enforced within 1e-6) into the unchanged sigmoid target and the
+  unchanged three first-order effector lags. Brain-level pressure (27 cm)
+  remains a distinct parameter used only for cerebral perfusion.
+- **Rationale.** A single head-level proxy conflated the carotid sinus with
+  the aortic arch and with brain perfusion; the sites experience different
+  hydrostatic corrections under tilt. Independent setpoints/scales allow
+  phenotype scenarios (e.g., the hypovolemic and mixed POTS pressure
+  setpoints) without implying a brain-pressure change.
+- **Alternative rejected.** Separate aortic and carotid effector pathways:
+  doubles the autonomic state space without evidence to identify it.
+- **Caveat.** The 0.25/0.75 weights are computational assumptions; legacy
+  phenotype `baroreflex_pressure_setpoint/scale` overrides were duplicated
+  onto both pathways unchanged, which preserves Stage 1 scenario semantics
+  but is not new evidence.
+- **Status.** Implemented and executed. Negative outcome preserved: all
+  four POTS phenotypes (17.428–19.659 bpm) and Long-COVID-autonomic
+  (18.931 bpm) FAIL the unchanged ≥30 bpm sustained-rise criterion that the
+  0.2.0 calibrated scenarios met; the criterion was not widened and gains
+  were not recalibrated.
+
+## D1.1-05 — Fixed effective cerebral outflow pressure of 5 mmHg
+
+- **Decision.** CPP = max(0, brain arterial pressure − 5 mmHg), replacing
+  the Stage 1 subtraction of the central-venous compartment pressure.
+- **Rationale.** Central venous pressure in this reduced model is a
+  preload-proxy compartment pressure, not the venous pressure opposing
+  cerebral outflow; subtracting it coupled the cerebral index to an
+  unrelated state. A fixed effective downstream pressure is the smallest
+  honest closure.
+- **Explicit non-claims.** The 5 mmHg value is **neither thoracic CVP nor a
+  resolved ICP**; no intracranial-pressure or venous-sinus state exists.
+- **Status.** Implemented and executed: the healthy end-tilt CFI
+  reduction is 1.645% at 70 degrees — the Stage 1 miss persists (still
+  below the unchanged 3–11% disclosure band) but narrowed from ~0.003%.
+
+## D1.1-06 — Declared end-tidal CO2 input with bounded exponential reactivity
+
+- **Decision.** Add optional per-segment `end_tidal_co2_mmHg`; default
+  reference 40 mmHg; cerebral-flow target multiplied by
+  `exp(0.035 × clip(ETCO2 − 40, ±15))`.
+- **Rationale.** Orthostatic hypocapnia is a documented cerebral-flow
+  mechanism that Stage 1 could not express. A declared segment input keeps
+  the scenario explicit and auditable.
+- **Deliberate restrictions.** (i) **No posture-inferred hypocapnia**—tilt
+  never changes ETCO2 by itself; (ii) **ETCO2 is not exact PaCO2**—no
+  end-tidal-to-arterial correction is modeled; (iii) the ±15 mmHg clip
+  bounds extrapolation of the exponential beyond the supported range.
+- **Status.** Implemented and executed; the five cerebral isolation
+  protocols confirm separability (pressure-only target 0.98355 with CO2
+  factor 1; CO2-only factor 0.70469 with pressure target 1; combined CFI
+  0.69310; recovery experiments remain separated).
+
+## D1.1-07 — Retained equations
+
+- **Decision.** The bounded pressure-autoregulation curve, the
+  preload/contractility stroke-volume equation, the chronotropic gain split,
+  muscle-pump and sustained-contraction mechanics, metabolic/extraction
+  constructs, and the PEM cascade are retained unchanged.
+- **Rationale.** Stage 1.1 scope is posture geometry, sensor separation,
+  flow partition, and the CO2 input; changing calibrated disease semantics
+  in the same revision would confound the rerun comparison.
+- **Status.** Retained; the Stage 1 misses attached to these equations
+  (early-CO, healthy-CFI, PEM onset timing) remain open.
+
+## D1.1-08 — Reporting windows and empirical anchors
+
+- **Decision.** Predefine time-resolved CO/SV/HR reporting windows per
+  protocol family and keep the Stage 1 protocol-specific empirical anchors
+  unchanged for the 0.3.0 rerun (see `validation-matrix.md`, sections 3–4).
+- **Rationale.** Predeclared windows prevent post-hoc window selection when
+  the rerun is evaluated; anchors stay fixed so the rerun is a comparison,
+  not a re-tuning.
+- **Status.** Windows and anchors declared and now populated by the
+  executed scenario matrix; all comparisons used the unchanged anchors,
+  and all eight Zaidi CO/SV comparisons MISS.
+
+## D1.1-09 — Scope guard
+
+- **Decision.** Stage 1.1 adds no synthetic data generation, no TSFM or
+  machine-learning component, and no Stage 2/Stage 3 capability.
+- **Status.** Standing; reaffirmed in `readiness-assessment.md`.
+
+## D1.1-10 — Independent-review corrections and scientific disposition
+
+- **Decision.** Require declared ETCO₂ values to be finite and positive, with
+  regression cases for NaN, positive and negative infinity, zero, and negative
+  values. Correct the technical handoff's opening summary so the current
+  five-compartment Stage 1.1 architecture is not described as the historical
+  four-compartment Stage 1 architecture.
+- **Rationale.** Non-finite ETCO₂ inputs can contaminate the cerebral CO₂
+  calculation and are not valid declared observations. Current architecture
+  and historical release records must remain unambiguous.
+- **Scientific disposition.** The independent review does not establish
+  scientific acceptance. The POTS sustained-HR failures, healthy CO/SV
+  discrepancies, uncertain baroreflex weighting and pressor response, and
+  pressure-versus-CO₂ cerebral-response balance remain unresolved. Focused
+  scientific remediation requires separately scoped Stage 1.2 work; Stage 2
+  remains held. No equation, parameter, calibration, validation threshold,
+  or scientific verdict is changed by these software/documentation fixes.
+- **Status.** Corrections implemented; scientific limitations and negative
+  results preserved without recalibration or threshold changes.

+## 2. New invariants introduced by 0.3.0
+
+- Five-volume conservation (analytic and integrated) replaces the
+  four-volume identity; the Stage 1 four-volume tests are superseded, not
+  deleted from history.
+- `aortic_baroreflex_weight + carotid_baroreflex_weight = 1` within 1e-6.
+- At `tilt_angle_deg = 0` every hydrostatic term is exactly zero and the
+  CO2 factor is exactly 1 at the 40 mmHg reference.
+- During a transition, only the angle varies; all other inputs are
+  piecewise constant.
+- Baseline systemic flow partition is 25/25/50 (splanchnic/lower-limb/
+  other) at the healthy operating point, with total stressed volume
+  2550 mL.
+
+## 3. Predefined time-resolved reporting windows (CO/SV/HR)
+
+Windows are declared **before** the rerun to prevent post-hoc selection.
+`t0` denotes the start of the first non-supine segment (120 s in the
+registered tilt/standing protocols). Statistics follow the existing
+`SimulationResult.metric` conventions.
+
+| Window | Definition | Reported quantities | Primary use |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Supine baseline | t ∈ [0, t0 − 2 s] | mean HR, CO, SV, MAP, venous return | Reference for all rises/reductions |
+| Transition | t ∈ [t0, t0 + transition_duration] | time-resolved HR, CO, SV, MAP | Active-stand (3 s) vs passive-tilt (30 s) transient shape |
+| Early upright | t ∈ [t0, t0 + 30 s] | min CO, min SV, min venous return, HR | Early orthostatic CO transient (Stage 1 soft anchor) |
+| Peak | t ∈ [t0, t0 + 300 s] | max HR; HR rise vs baseline | Peak orthostatic HR rise (secondary POTS metric) |
+| Sustained | final 120 s of the upright/standing segment | mean HR; sustained HR rise; late regional volumes | **Primary** POTS scenario criterion; caudal volume accumulation |
+| Recovery (tilt-back) | t ∈ [600, 1200] of `tilt-recovery` | time-resolved HR, CO, SV, CFI recovery | Tilt-back recovery dynamics |
+
+The same window definitions apply to the cerebral CO2 protocols with the
+segment boundaries declared in their YAMLs; no window is fitted to an
+observed feature.
+

+## 5. Preserved Stage 1 misses and new 0.3.0 negative results
+
+1. **Healthy CO/SV orthostatic miss — persists.** Stage 1: early CO
+   reduction ~5.64% vs the broad 10–30% soft band. Stage 1.1: sustained CO
+   −3.105% and SV −12.733% at 70 degrees, and **all eight** Zaidi
+   (REF-ZAIDI-2000) 60/70-degree, 2/5-minute CO/SV comparisons MISS the
+   published ranges newly predeclared for this Stage 1.1 comparison. The reduced-order structure still
+   underrepresents the orthostatic CO/SV reduction; this is reported as a
+   negative result, not tuned.
+2. **Healthy end-tilt CFI miss — persists, narrowed.** Stage 1: ~0.003% vs
+   the 3–11% disclosure band around the ~7% control finding. Stage 1.1:
+   1.645% at 70 degrees (0.819/1.192/1.497% at 30/45/60 degrees) — still
+   below the unchanged band. The historical 0.003% value remains the Stage
+   1 record.
+3. **PEM onset-timing caveat — stands.** PEM equations are unchanged; the
+   scenario checks were re-executed in the full release suite without a PEM
+   warning, and the ~5.7 h first-0.05 crossing caveat (peak ~39.2 h) is
+   retained unchanged.
+4. **Historical hEDS grid failures — preserved.** The pre-revision
+   below-70-mmHg MAP grid failures (minimum ~37.84 mmHg) remain archived
+   under `validation/baseline/stage0/`; the hEDS venous-compliance scenario
+   remains M2. The 0.3.0 hEDS tilt run (sustained HR rise 12.448 bpm, final
+   MAP 111.195 mmHg) shows no below-70-mmHg regime in that protocol.
+5. **NEW — POTS sustained-HR criterion failure.** All four POTS phenotypes
+   and the Long-COVID-autonomic phenotype now FAIL the unchanged ≥30 bpm
+   sustained-rise criterion (17.428–19.659 bpm range). Under 0.2.0 the
+   calibrated scenarios met it; the dual-sensor integrated baroreflex and
+   re-partitioned resistances changed the sustained response. This is a
+   preserved negative result: the criterion was not widened and the gains
+   were not recalibrated.
+
+## 6. Executed cerebral pressure/CO2 isolation experiments (0.3.0)
+
+The five `simulations/cerebral/` protocols were executed; they confirm the
+designed separability of the pressure and CO2 pathways:
+
+| Protocol | Final brain arterial pressure (mmHg) | Final ETCO2 (mmHg) | Pressure target | CO2 factor | Final CFI |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| `pressure-reduction` | 92.668 | 40.0 | 0.98355 | 1.00000 | 0.98355 |
+| `co2-reduction` | 100.000 | 30.0 | 1.00000 | 0.70469 | 0.70469 |
+| `combined-pressure-co2-reduction` | 92.668 | 30.0 | 0.98355 | 0.70469 | 0.69310 |
+| `pressure-recovery-persistent-hypocapnia` | 100.000 | 30.0 | 1.00000 | 0.70469 | 0.70469 |
+| `co2-recovery-persistent-pressure-reduction` | 92.668 | 40.0 | 0.98355 | 1.00000 | 0.98355 |
+
+Interpretation: the isolated pressure reduction moves the CFI only to
+0.98355 while an ETCO2 step to 30 mmHg moves it to 0.70469 (the
+`exp(0.035 × −10)` factor), and the combined experiment gives 0.69310 —
+the declared CO2 pathway dominates the cerebral response in this structure.
+The two recovery experiments remain separated: pressure recovery with
+persistent hypocapnia does **not** restore CFI (0.70469 persists), and CO2
+recovery with persistent pressure reduction leaves the 0.98355 pressure
+signature — confirming there is no posture-inferred hypocapnia and no
+cross-coupling between the two pathways.
+

 ## B. Scientific findings and interpretation
 
 The focused review supports separate splanchnic and lower-limb pooling paths, pressure-gradient-driven venous return, rhythmic muscle-pump transfer, sustained-contraction impediment, faster vagal than sympathetic cardiac control, distinguishable cardiac and vascular sympathetic pathways, head-level cerebral perfusion pressure, and dynamic cerebral autoregulation. It also preserves constraining findings: tilt and LBNP are not interchangeable, muscle pump is not the sole mechanism of exercise CO augmentation, and regional impedance/TCD surrogates are not absolute volume or flow measurements.

 # Changelog — ocpe:disease-models
 
+## 0.3.0
+
+- Added the Stage 1.1 twelve-state declaration with a fifth conserved
+  other-systemic venous volume and a three-way systemic flow partition.
+- Separated aortic and carotid baroreceptor pressures from brain arterial
+  pressure; declared their distinct hydrostatic heights and integrated reflex.
+- Added explicit tilt-angle, transition-duration and segment end-tidal-CO2
+  inputs, plus bounded CO2-dependent cerebral vascular regulation.
+- Declared the fixed effective cerebral outflow-pressure approximation without
+  treating it as thoracic central venous pressure or resolved intracranial
+  pressure.
+

       - The exertional-load/delayed-stress/PEM cascade is an explicitly phenomenological exertion-delay-recovery approximation, not a claim that the cellular cause of PEM is known.
     limitations:

+      - Hydrostatics enter as lumped height times sin(tilt angle) corrections; there is no distributed postural geometry, venous-valve or column-collapse dynamics.
       - Cerebral flow index is a lumped perfusion-pressure approximation with a residual autoregulation slope, not vessel-level autoregulation.
       - No transcapillary fluid exchange, haemorrhage or renal volume regulation; blood volume changes only through the blood volume factor operating point.
       - Metabolic capacity, oxygen extraction and PEM dynamics are phenomenological couplings; their parameters are calibration assumptions, not clinical measurements.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate the Stage 1.1 time-resolved scientific comparison matrix.
+
+The report is a deterministic research-scenario comparison, not a synthetic
+cohort, fitted patient dataset, or clinical validation. Threshold misses are
+reported as misses; this script never changes model parameters or criteria.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
+
+from ocpe_disease_models.config import compose_phenotypes, load_protocol  # noqa: E402
+
+SOLVER_KEYS = {"sample_interval", "max_step", "rtol", "atol", "seed"}
+OFFSETS_S = (0.0, 10.0, 30.0, 60.0, 120.0, 300.0)
+GRADED_PROTOCOLS = (
+    "passive-tilt-30",
+    "passive-tilt-45",
+    "passive-tilt-60",
+    "passive-tilt-70",
+)
+TILT_PHENOTYPES = (
+    "healthy-reference",
+    "pots-neuropathic",
+    "pots-hyperadrenergic",
+    "pots-hypovolemic",
+    "pots-mixed",
+    "long-covid-autonomic",
+    "long-covid-exertional",
+    "eds-heds-vascular",
+    "mecfs-pem",
+)
+CEREBRAL_PROTOCOLS = (
+    "pressure-reduction",
+    "co2-reduction",
+    "combined-pressure-co2-reduction",
+    "pressure-recovery-persistent-hypocapnia",
+    "co2-recovery-persistent-pressure-reduction",
+)
+
+
+def _run(phenotype_id: str, protocol_id: str):
+    patient = compose_phenotypes([phenotype_id], root=ROOT)
+    segments, settings = load_protocol(protocol_id, root=ROOT)
+    solver = {key: value for key, value in settings.items() if key in SOLVER_KEYS}
+    return patient.simulate(segments, **solver)
+
+
+def _mean(result, name: str, start: float, end: float) -> float:
+    mask = (result.time >= start) & (result.time <= end)
+    if not np.any(mask):
+        raise ValueError(f"No samples for {name} in [{start}, {end}]")
+    return float(np.mean(result.outputs[name][mask]))
+
+
+def _point(result, time_s: float, name: str) -> float:
+    index = int(np.argmin(np.abs(result.time - time_s)))
+    return float(result.outputs[name][index])
+
+
+def _orthostatic_record(phenotype_id: str, protocol_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = _run(phenotype_id, protocol_id)
+    first_upright = next(
+        segment for segment in result.protocol if segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg() > 0
+    )
+    first_index = next(
+        index for index, segment in enumerate(result.protocol) if segment is first_upright
+    )
+    start = first_upright.start
+    upright_end = first_upright.end
+    for segment in result.protocol[first_index + 1 :]:
+        if segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg() <= 0:
+            break
+        upright_end = segment.end
+    end = min(upright_end, float(result.time[-1]))
+    baseline: dict[str, float] = {}
+    for name in (
+        "heart_rate",
+        "stroke_volume",
+        "cardiac_output",
+        "mean_arterial_pressure",
+        "cerebral_flow_index",
+        "venous_return",
+    ):
+        baseline[name] = _mean(result, name, 0.0, max(0.0, start - 2.0))
+    points = []
+    for offset in OFFSETS_S:
+        if start + offset > end:
+            continue
+        time_s = start + offset
+        hr = _point(result, time_s, "heart_rate")
+        sv = _point(result, time_s, "stroke_volume")
+        co = _point(result, time_s, "cardiac_output")
+        points.append(
+            {
+                "offset_s": offset,
+                "time_s": time_s,
+                "heart_rate_bpm": hr,
+                "heart_rate_rise_bpm": hr - baseline["heart_rate"],
+                "stroke_volume_change_pct": 100.0 * (sv / baseline["stroke_volume"] - 1.0),
+                "cardiac_output_change_pct": 100.0 * (co / baseline["cardiac_output"] - 1.0),
+                "mean_arterial_pressure_mmHg": _point(result, time_s, "mean_arterial_pressure"),
+                "brain_arterial_pressure_mmHg": _point(result, time_s, "brain_arterial_pressure"),
+                "cerebral_flow_index": _point(result, time_s, "cerebral_flow_index"),
+                "end_tidal_co2_mmHg": _point(result, time_s, "end_tidal_co2_mmHg"),
+                "tilt_angle_deg": _point(result, time_s, "tilt_angle_deg"),
+            }
+        )
+    early_end = min(start + 30.0, end)
+    peak_end = min(start + 300.0, end)
+    early_co = result.metric("cardiac_output", start, early_end, "min")
+    early_sv = result.metric("stroke_volume", start, early_end, "min")
+    sustained_start = max(start, end - 120.0)
+    sustained_hr = _mean(result, "heart_rate", sustained_start, end)
+    total = result.states[:5].sum(axis=0)
+    record = {
+        "phenotype_id": phenotype_id,
+        "protocol_id": protocol_id,
+        "configuration_sha256": result.metadata["configuration_sha256"],
+        "solver": result.metadata["solver"],
+        "baseline_window_s": [0.0, max(0.0, start - 2.0)],
+        "baseline": baseline,
+        "points": points,
+        "early_upright_window_s": [start, early_end],
+        "early_min_cardiac_output_change_pct": 100.0
+        * (early_co / baseline["cardiac_output"] - 1.0),
+        "early_min_stroke_volume_change_pct": 100.0
+        * (early_sv / baseline["stroke_volume"] - 1.0),
+        "early_min_venous_return_mL_s": result.metric("venous_return", start, early_end, "min"),
+        "peak_window_s": [start, peak_end],
+        "peak_heart_rate_rise_bpm": result.metric("heart_rate", start, peak_end, "max")
+        - baseline["heart_rate"],
+        "sustained_window_s": [sustained_start, end],
+        "sustained_heart_rate_rise_bpm": sustained_hr - baseline["heart_rate"],
+        "upright_end_mean_arterial_pressure_mmHg": _mean(
+            result, "mean_arterial_pressure", max(start, end - 10.0), end
+        ),
+        "end_cerebral_flow_reduction_pct": 100.0
+        * (1.0 - _mean(result, "cerebral_flow_index", end - 10.0, end) / baseline["cerebral_flow_index"]),
+        "maximum_five_volume_drift_mL": float(np.max(np.abs(total - total[0]))),
+    }
+    if any(
+        segment.start >= upright_end and segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg() == 0
+        for segment in result.protocol
+    ):
+        recovery_points = []
+        for offset in OFFSETS_S:
+            time_s = upright_end + offset
+            if time_s > float(result.time[-1]):
+                continue
+            hr = _point(result, time_s, "heart_rate")
+            sv = _point(result, time_s, "stroke_volume")
+            co = _point(result, time_s, "cardiac_output")
+            recovery_points.append(
+                {
+                    "offset_s": offset,
+                    "time_s": time_s,
+                    "heart_rate_rise_bpm": hr - baseline["heart_rate"],
+                    "stroke_volume_change_pct": 100.0 * (sv / baseline["stroke_volume"] - 1.0),
+                    "cardiac_output_change_pct": 100.0 * (co / baseline["cardiac_output"] - 1.0),
+                    "cerebral_flow_index": _point(result, time_s, "cerebral_flow_index"),
+                    "tilt_angle_deg": _point(result, time_s, "tilt_angle_deg"),
+                }
+            )
+        record["tilt_back_recovery_points"] = recovery_points
+    if phenotype_id.startswith("pots-") or phenotype_id == "long-covid-autonomic":
+        record["sustained_30_bpm_criterion"] = {
+            "threshold_bpm": 30.0,
+            "status": "PASS" if record["sustained_heart_rate_rise_bpm"] >= 30.0 else "FAIL",
+            "interpretation": "Unchanged scenario criterion; failure is retained without gain recalibration.",
+        }
+    return record
+
+
+def _cerebral_record(protocol_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = _run("healthy-reference", protocol_id)
+    final = {name: float(result.outputs[name][-1]) for name in (
+        "mean_arterial_pressure",
+        "brain_arterial_pressure",
+        "cerebral_perfusion_pressure",
+        "end_tidal_co2_mmHg",
+        "cerebral_pressure_target",
+        "cerebral_co2_factor",
+        "cerebral_flow_target",
+        "cerebral_flow_index",
+    )}
+    total = result.states[:5].sum(axis=0)
+    return {
+        "protocol_id": protocol_id,
+        "configuration_sha256": result.metadata["configuration_sha256"],
+        "segments": [
+            {
+                "start": segment.start,
+                "end": segment.end,
+                "label": segment.label,
+                "tilt_angle_deg": segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg(),
+                "end_tidal_co2_mmHg": segment.end_tidal_co2_mmHg,
+            }
+            for segment in result.protocol
+        ],
+        "final": final,
+        "maximum_five_volume_drift_mL": float(np.max(np.abs(total - total[0]))),
+    }
+
+
+def _empirical_comparisons(orthostatic: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    comparisons = []
+    for record in orthostatic:
+        if record["phenotype_id"] != "healthy-reference" or record["protocol_id"] not in {
+            "passive-tilt-60",
+            "passive-tilt-70",
+        }:
+            continue
+        for point in record["points"]:
+            if point["offset_s"] not in {120.0, 300.0}:
+                continue
+            for metric, band in (
+                ("cardiac_output_change_pct", (-20.0, -17.0)),
+                ("stroke_volume_change_pct", (-34.0, -28.0)),
+            ):
+                value = point[metric]
+                comparisons.append(
+                    {
+                        "reference_id": "REF-ZAIDI-2000",
+                        "protocol_id": record["protocol_id"],
+                        "offset_s": point["offset_s"],
+                        "metric": metric,
+                        "model_value_pct": value,
+                        "published_group_range_pct": list(band),
+                        "status": "WITHIN" if band[0] <= value <= band[1] else "MISS",
+                        "interpretation": "Protocol-specific healthy group plausibility comparison, not a fitted target or external validation.",
+                    }
+                )
+    return comparisons
+
+
+def _markdown(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    lines = [
+        "# Stage 1.1 time-resolved scientific comparison matrix",

+                f"| {row['early_min_stroke_volume_change_pct']:.3f} | {row['peak_heart_rate_rise_bpm']:.3f} "
+                f"| {row['sustained_heart_rate_rise_bpm']:.3f} |"
+            )
+    lines.extend([

+        "",
+        "Offsets are measured from the upright segment start; posture during the declared transition is explicitly reported in JSON.",

+        "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",

+        if row["phenotype_id"] != "healthy-reference":
+            continue
+        for point in row["points"]:
+            lines.append(

+                f"| {point['cardiac_output_change_pct']:.3f} | {point['stroke_volume_change_pct']:.3f} "
+                f"| {point['mean_arterial_pressure_mmHg']:.3f} | {point['cerebral_flow_index']:.5f} |"
+            )
+    recovery_rows = [
+        (row, point)
+        for row in payload["orthostatic"]
+        for point in row.get("tilt_back_recovery_points", [])
+    ]
+    if recovery_rows:
+        lines.extend([
+            "",
+            "## Tilt-back recovery",
+            "",
+            "Offsets are measured from the start of the supine recovery segment; the declared 30-second return transition is included.",
+            "",
+            "| Protocol | Offset (s) | HR rise vs supine baseline (bpm) | CO change (%) | SV change (%) | CFI | Tilt (deg) |",
+            "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
+        ])
+        for row, point in recovery_rows:
+            lines.append(
+                f"| {row['protocol_id']} | {point['offset_s']:.0f} | {point['heart_rate_rise_bpm']:.3f} "

+        "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
+    ])
+    for row in payload["cerebral_experiments"]:
+        final = row["final"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {row['protocol_id']} | {final['brain_arterial_pressure']:.3f} | {final['end_tidal_co2_mmHg']:.1f} "
+            f"| {final['cerebral_pressure_target']:.5f} | {final['cerebral_co2_factor']:.5f} | {final['cerebral_flow_index']:.5f} |"
+        )
+    misses = sum(row["status"] == "MISS" for row in payload["empirical_comparisons"])
+    criterion_failures = sum(
+        row.get("sustained_30_bpm_criterion", {}).get("status") == "FAIL"
+        for row in payload["orthostatic"]
+    )
+    lines.extend([
+        "",
+        "## Readiness interpretation",
+        "",
+        f"- Empirical CO/SV comparisons outside their preserved published ranges: **{misses}**.",
+        f"- POTS/Long-COVID-autonomic sustained-HR criterion failures: **{criterion_failures}**.",
+        "- Software execution and exact volume conservation do not resolve these physiological discrepancies.",
+        "- Stage 1.1 readiness therefore remains limited even when mathematical and traceability checks pass.",
+        "",
+    ])
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+

+def main() -> int:
+    protocols = [
+        *GRADED_PROTOCOLS,
+        "head-up-tilt",
+        "active-standing",
+        "inactive-standing",
+        "tilt-recovery",
+    ]
+    orthostatic = [_orthostatic_record("healthy-reference", protocol) for protocol in protocols]
+    orthostatic.extend(
+        _orthostatic_record(phenotype, "head-up-tilt")
+        for phenotype in TILT_PHENOTYPES
+        if phenotype != "healthy-reference"
+    )
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "1.0",
+        "model_version": "0.3.0",
+        "clinical_status": "Research scenario comparisons only; not clinical validation.",
+        "analysis_policy": "No gain recalibration, threshold widening, synthetic cohort, or posture-inferred hypocapnia.",
+        "orthostatic": orthostatic,
+        "empirical_comparisons": _empirical_comparisons(orthostatic),
+        "cerebral_experiments": [_cerebral_record(protocol) for protocol in CEREBRAL_PROTOCOLS],
+    }
+    out_dir = ROOT / "validation" / "stage1-1"
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (out_dir / "scientific-comparison-matrix.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    (out_dir / "scientific-comparison-matrix.md").write_text(
+        _markdown(payload), encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    print(f"Wrote Stage 1.1 comparison matrix to {out_dir}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+    """A constant-input segment of a simulation protocol.
+
+    Posture is specified either by the legacy ``upright`` fraction (mapped to
+    a tilt angle through ``arcsin(upright)``, so 1.0 is 90 degrees) or by an
+    explicit ``tilt_angle_deg`` in [0, 90]; specifying both is an error.
+    During ``transition_duration`` the posture angle is linearly interpolated
+    from the previous segment's angle; all other inputs remain piecewise
+    constant. ``end_tidal_co2_mmHg=None`` selects the model reference value.
+    """

+    def resolved_tilt_angle_deg(self) -> float:
+        """Resolve the segment's steady posture angle in degrees."""
+        if self.tilt_angle_deg is not None:
+            return self.tilt_angle_deg
+        if self.upright is not None:
+            return math.degrees(math.asin(self.upright))
+        return 0.0
+
+    def resolved_end_tidal_co2(self, reference_mmHg: float) -> float:
+        """Resolve end-tidal CO2, falling back to the model reference."""
+        if self.end_tidal_co2_mmHg is None:
+            return reference_mmHg
+        return self.end_tidal_co2_mmHg

+def _reduction_pct_at_offset(result, offset_s: float) -> float:
+    """CFI reduction (%) at ``offset_s`` seconds after tilt onset."""
+    t = result.time
+    cfi = result.outputs["cerebral_flow_index"]
+    baseline = float(cfi[(t >= 0.0) & (t <= TILT_START - 2.0)].mean())
+    value = float(cfi[_at(result, TILT_START + offset_s)])
+    return 100.0 * (baseline - value) / baseline
+
+
+def test_cerebral_flow_reduction_time_course_is_group_separated(
+    mecfs_tilt_recovery_result, healthy_tilt_recovery_result
+):
+    """Protocol-specific time-resolved comparison along the head-up tilt.
+
+    Reductions are compared at immediate (0 s, transition onset), 10 s, 30 s,
+    60 s, 2 min and 5 min after tilt onset plus the sustained end-tilt window.
+    The ME/CFS group must separate above the healthy control at every resolved
+    post-onset time point; no additional numeric thresholds are introduced.
+    """
+    offsets = {
+        "immediate": 0.0,
+        "10s": 10.0,
+        "30s": 30.0,
+        "60s": 60.0,
+        "2min": 120.0,
+        "5min": 300.0,
+    }
+    healthy = {
+        label: _reduction_pct_at_offset(healthy_tilt_recovery_result, off)
+        for label, off in offsets.items()
+    }
+    mecfs = {
+        label: _reduction_pct_at_offset(mecfs_tilt_recovery_result, off)
+        for label, off in offsets.items()
+    }
+    healthy["sustained"] = _end_tilt_reduction_pct(healthy_tilt_recovery_result)
+    mecfs["sustained"] = _end_tilt_reduction_pct(mecfs_tilt_recovery_result)
+    # At transition onset neither group has responded yet.
+    assert healthy["immediate"] == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-6)
+    assert mecfs["immediate"] == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-6)
+    # Group separation at every resolved post-onset time point.
+    for label in ("10s", "30s", "60s", "2min", "5min", "sustained"):
+        assert mecfs[label] > healthy[label], (
+            f"no group separation at {label}: ME/CFS {mecfs[label]:.2f}% "
+            f"vs healthy {healthy[label]:.2f}%"
+        )
+    # The 5 min reading has reached the sustained end-tilt level in both groups.
+    assert mecfs["5min"] == pytest.approx(mecfs["sustained"], abs=1.0)
+    assert healthy["5min"] == pytest.approx(healthy["sustained"], abs=1.0)
+

+"""VAL-PHYS-CBF-CO2: Stage 1.1 cerebral pressure/CO2 regulation (physiological).
+
+Covers the separated aortic/carotid/brain hydrostatic pressures, the fixed
+5 mmHg effective cerebral outflow pressure (explicitly not thoracic CVP or a
+resolved ICP), explicit end-tidal CO2 forcing with bounded extrapolation, and
+the persistent one-factor recovery protocols (pressure recovery with
+persistent hypocapnia; CO2 recovery with persistent pressure reduction).
+Protocols are constructed inline so these mechanisms are tested independently
+of the simulation registry contents.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared import ComputationalPatient, ModelParameters
+from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared.model import (
+    HYDROSTATIC_MMHG_PER_CM,
+    ProtocolSegment,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.physiological
+
+TILT_START = 120.0
+TILT_END = 600.0
+RECOVERY_END = 1200.0
+TRANSITION = 30.0
+
+
+def _supine_then_tilt(angle_deg: float = 70.0, **kwargs) -> list[ProtocolSegment]:
+    return [
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=0.0, label="supine"),
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=TILT_START,
+            end=TILT_END,
+            tilt_angle_deg=angle_deg,
+            transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+            label="tilt",
+            **kwargs,
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+def _expected_co2_factor(etco2: float, p: ModelParameters) -> float:
+    deviation = float(
+        np.clip(
+            etco2 - p.end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg,
+            -p.cerebral_co2_extrapolation_limit_mmHg,
+            p.cerebral_co2_extrapolation_limit_mmHg,
+        )
+    )
+    return math.exp(p.cerebral_co2_reactivity_per_mmHg * deviation)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------- pressure separation (Stage 1.1)
+def test_aortic_carotid_and_brain_pressures_separate_with_tilt():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    protocol = _supine_then_tilt()
+    supine = patient._inputs(0.0, protocol, p.end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg)
+    assert supine.tilt_angle_deg == 0.0
+    d_supine = patient._derived(0.0, state, protocol)
+    # Supine: no hydrostatic gradient, all measurement sites equal Pa.
+    assert d_supine["aortic_baroreceptor_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        d_supine["arterial_pressure"]
+    )
+    assert d_supine["carotid_sinus_pressure"] == pytest.approx(d_supine["arterial_pressure"])
+    assert d_supine["brain_arterial_pressure"] == pytest.approx(d_supine["arterial_pressure"])
+    # Tilted (steady 70 degrees): pressures separate by height above the heart.
+    t_tilted = TILT_START + TRANSITION + 1.0
+    d_tilted = patient._derived(t_tilted, state, protocol)
+    sin70 = math.sin(math.radians(70.0))
+    pa = d_tilted["arterial_pressure"]
+    assert d_tilted["aortic_baroreceptor_pressure"] == pytest.approx(pa)  # heart level
+    assert d_tilted["carotid_sinus_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        pa - HYDROSTATIC_MMHG_PER_CM * p.carotid_baroreceptor_height_cm * sin70
+    )
+    assert d_tilted["brain_arterial_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        pa - HYDROSTATIC_MMHG_PER_CM * p.brain_hydrostatic_height_cm * sin70
+    )
+    assert (
+        d_tilted["aortic_baroreceptor_pressure"]
+        > d_tilted["carotid_sinus_pressure"]
+        > d_tilted["brain_arterial_pressure"]
+    )
+
+
+def test_integrated_baroreflex_input_combines_aortic_and_carotid_errors():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    protocol = _supine_then_tilt()
+    d = patient._derived(TILT_START + TRANSITION + 1.0, state, protocol)
+    e_a = (
+        p.aortic_baroreflex_pressure_setpoint - d["aortic_baroreceptor_pressure"]
+    ) / p.aortic_baroreflex_pressure_scale
+    e_c = (
+        p.carotid_baroreflex_pressure_setpoint - d["carotid_sinus_pressure"]
+    ) / p.carotid_baroreflex_pressure_scale
+    expected = p.aortic_baroreflex_weight * e_a + p.carotid_baroreflex_weight * e_c
+    assert d["integrated_baroreflex_input"] == pytest.approx(expected, rel=1e-12)
+    assert d["baroreflex_target"] == pytest.approx(
+        1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-expected)), rel=1e-12
+    )
+
+
+def test_cpp_uses_fixed_outflow_pressure_not_central_venous_pressure():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    protocol = _supine_then_tilt()
+    d = patient._derived(TILT_START + TRANSITION + 1.0, state, protocol)
+    assert d["cerebral_outflow_pressure"] == p.cerebral_outflow_pressure_mmHg == 5.0
+    assert d["cerebral_perfusion_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        max(0.0, d["brain_arterial_pressure"] - d["cerebral_outflow_pressure"])
+    )
+    # Raising central venous pressure must not change CPP at fixed arterial state.
+    raised = state.copy()
+    raised[1] *= 1.5  # central_venous_volume
+    d_raised = patient._derived(TILT_START + TRANSITION + 1.0, raised, protocol)
+    assert d_raised["central_venous_pressure"] > d["central_venous_pressure"]
+    assert d_raised["cerebral_perfusion_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        d["cerebral_perfusion_pressure"]
+    )
+

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------- CO2 input
+def test_absent_end_tidal_co2_means_model_reference():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    implicit = patient._derived(0.0, state, [ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0)])
+    explicit = patient._derived(
+        0.0,
+        state,
+        [
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=0.0, end=10.0, end_tidal_co2_mmHg=p.end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg
+            )
+        ],
+    )
+    assert implicit["end_tidal_co2_mmHg"] == p.end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg == 40.0
+    assert implicit["cerebral_co2_factor"] == 1.0
+    assert implicit["cerebral_flow_target"] == explicit["cerebral_flow_target"]
+

+def test_co2_factor_is_bounded_and_symmetric_around_reference():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    for etco2 in (40.0, 30.0, 50.0):
+        d = patient._derived(
+            0.0, state, [ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, end_tidal_co2_mmHg=etco2)]
+        )
+        assert d["cerebral_co2_factor"] == pytest.approx(_expected_co2_factor(etco2, p))
+        # Pressure curve is untouched by the CO2 input (isolation).
+        assert d["cerebral_pressure_target"] == pytest.approx(1.0)
+        assert d["cerebral_flow_target"] == pytest.approx(
+            d["cerebral_pressure_target"] * d["cerebral_co2_factor"]
+        )
+
+
+def test_co2_extrapolation_limit_clips_to_plateaus():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+
+    def factor(etco2):
+        return patient._derived(
+            0.0, state, [ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, end_tidal_co2_mmHg=etco2)]
+        )["cerebral_co2_factor"]
+
+    low_plateau = _expected_co2_factor(
+        p.end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg - p.cerebral_co2_extrapolation_limit_mmHg, p
+    )
+    high_plateau = _expected_co2_factor(
+        p.end_tidal_co2_reference_mmHg + p.cerebral_co2_extrapolation_limit_mmHg, p
+    )
+    assert factor(25.0) == pytest.approx(low_plateau)  # at the limit
+    assert factor(10.0) == pytest.approx(low_plateau)  # beyond the limit: clipped
+    assert factor(55.0) == pytest.approx(high_plateau)
+    assert factor(70.0) == pytest.approx(high_plateau)
+
+
+def test_pressure_and_co2_factors_are_independent_and_multiplicative():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    protocol_pressure_only = _supine_then_tilt(end_tidal_co2_mmHg=40.0)
+    protocol_combined = _supine_then_tilt(end_tidal_co2_mmHg=30.0)
+    t_tilted = TILT_START + TRANSITION + 1.0
+    d_pressure = patient._derived(t_tilted, state, protocol_pressure_only)
+    d_combined = patient._derived(t_tilted, state, protocol_combined)
+    # Same posture and state: identical pressure-side quantities.
+    assert d_combined["brain_arterial_pressure"] == d_pressure["brain_arterial_pressure"]
+    assert d_combined["cerebral_perfusion_pressure"] == d_pressure[
+        "cerebral_perfusion_pressure"
+    ]
+    assert d_combined["cerebral_pressure_target"] == d_pressure["cerebral_pressure_target"]
+    # The CO2 factor enters purely multiplicatively.
+    ratio = d_combined["cerebral_flow_target"] / d_pressure["cerebral_flow_target"]
+    assert ratio == pytest.approx(_expected_co2_factor(30.0, patient.parameters), rel=1e-12)
+    assert ratio < 1.0
+
+
+def test_co2_sensitivity_parameters_move_the_response_as_declared():
+    """CO2 sensitivity coverage: reactivity scales the factor slope and the
+    extrapolation limit moves the clipping plateau."""
+    p = ModelParameters()
+    state = ComputationalPatient().initial_state()
+
+    def factor(parameters: ModelParameters, etco2: float) -> float:
+        patient = ComputationalPatient(parameters)
+        return patient._derived(
+            0.0, state, [ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, end_tidal_co2_mmHg=etco2)]
+        )["cerebral_co2_factor"]
+
+    more_reactive = p.replaced({"cerebral_co2_reactivity_per_mmHg": 2.0 * p.cerebral_co2_reactivity_per_mmHg})
+    # Larger reactivity: larger |factor - 1| for the same in-range deviation.
+    assert factor(more_reactive, 30.0) < factor(p, 30.0) < 1.0
+    assert factor(more_reactive, 50.0) > factor(p, 50.0) > 1.0
+    # Wider limit: the same extreme ETCO2 no longer clips at the old plateau.
+    wider_limit = p.replaced({"cerebral_co2_extrapolation_limit_mmHg": 25.0})
+    # At ETCO2 20 mmHg the deviation (-20) exceeds the default limit (15) but
+    # fits inside the widened one, so the wider-limit model responds more.
+    assert factor(wider_limit, 20.0) < factor(p, 20.0)
+    assert factor(wider_limit, 20.0) == pytest.approx(
+        math.exp(p.cerebral_co2_reactivity_per_mmHg * -20.0)
+    )
+
+
+# --------------------------------------- persistent one-factor recovery runs
+def _run(segments) -> object:
+    return ComputationalPatient().simulate(segments, sample_interval=2.0)
+
+
+def test_pressure_recovery_with_persistent_hypocapnia_limits_recovery():
+    """Tilt-back restores pressure geometry but ETCO2 stays low: the cerebral
+    index recovers only to the CO2-factor floor, not to baseline."""
+    result = _run(
+        [
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=0.0, end_tidal_co2_mmHg=40.0
+            ),
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=TILT_START,
+                end=TILT_END,
+                tilt_angle_deg=70.0,
+                transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+                end_tidal_co2_mmHg=30.0,
+            ),
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=TILT_END,
+                end=RECOVERY_END,
+                tilt_angle_deg=0.0,
+                transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+                end_tidal_co2_mmHg=30.0,
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+    cfi = result.outputs["cerebral_flow_index"]
+    baseline = float(cfi[result.time <= TILT_START - 2.0].mean())
+    floor = _expected_co2_factor(30.0, result.parameters)
+    final = float(cfi[-1])
+    assert baseline == pytest.approx(1.0, abs=1e-9)
+    assert result.outputs["cerebral_co2_factor"][-1] == pytest.approx(floor)
+    # Pressure geometry is fully restored supine...
+    assert result.outputs["cerebral_pressure_target"][-1] == pytest.approx(1.0, abs=1e-3)
+    # ...but the persistent hypocapnia holds the index at the CO2 floor.
+    assert final == pytest.approx(floor, abs=0.02)
+    assert final < baseline - 0.2
+
+
+def test_co2_recovery_with_persistent_pressure_reduction_limits_recovery():
+    """ETCO2 returns to reference while the 70 degree tilt persists: the index
+    recovers from the combined reduction only up to the tilted pressure target."""
+    result = _run(
+        [
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=0.0, end_tidal_co2_mmHg=40.0
+            ),
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=TILT_START,
+                end=TILT_END,
+                tilt_angle_deg=70.0,
+                transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+                end_tidal_co2_mmHg=30.0,
+            ),
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=TILT_END,
+                end=RECOVERY_END,
+                tilt_angle_deg=70.0,
+                end_tidal_co2_mmHg=40.0,
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+    cfi = result.outputs["cerebral_flow_index"]
+    t = result.time
+    combined = float(cfi[np.argmin(np.abs(t - TILT_END))])
+    final = float(cfi[-1])
+    floor = _expected_co2_factor(30.0, result.parameters)
+    assert result.outputs["cerebral_co2_factor"][-1] == pytest.approx(1.0)
+    # Recovery above the hypocapnic floor but capped by the persisting tilt.
+    assert combined < floor
+    assert final > floor + 0.1
+    assert final < 1.0
+    assert final == pytest.approx(
+        float(result.outputs["cerebral_pressure_target"][-1]), abs=0.02
+    )

+def _expected_baroreflex_target(patient: ComputationalPatient, tilt_angle_deg: float) -> float:
+    """Integrated aortic/carotid baroreflex target for the default initial state."""
+    p = patient.parameters
+    sin_tilt = math.sin(math.radians(tilt_angle_deg))
+    pa = p.arterial_volume_initial / p.arterial_compliance
+    p_aortic = max(0.0, pa - HYDROSTATIC_MMHG_PER_CM * p.aortic_baroreceptor_height_cm * sin_tilt)
+    p_carotid = max(
+        0.0, pa - HYDROSTATIC_MMHG_PER_CM * p.carotid_baroreceptor_height_cm * sin_tilt
+    )
+    error = (
+        p.aortic_baroreflex_weight
+        * (p.aortic_baroreflex_pressure_setpoint - p_aortic)
+        / p.aortic_baroreflex_pressure_scale
+        + p.carotid_baroreflex_weight
+        * (p.carotid_baroreflex_pressure_setpoint - p_carotid)
+        / p.carotid_baroreflex_pressure_scale
+    )
+    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-float(np.clip(error, -40.0, 40.0))))

+"""VAL-PHYS-TILT-ANGLE and VAL-PHYS-GRADED-TILT (layer: physiological).
+
+Stage 1.1 posture specification semantics: the dual posture specification
+(legacy ``upright`` fraction versus explicit ``tilt_angle_deg``), mutual
+exclusion, arcsin equivalence, linear angle-only transitions from the prior
+segment, and graded-tilt monotonicity. Protocols are constructed inline so
+these semantics are tested independently of the simulation registry contents.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared import ComputationalPatient
+from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared.model import ProtocolSegment
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.physiological
+
+TILT_START = 120.0
+TILT_END = 600.0
+TRANSITION = 30.0
+
+
+def _patient() -> ComputationalPatient:
+    return ComputationalPatient()
+
+
+def _simulate(segments, **kwargs):
+    return _patient().simulate(segments, sample_interval=2.0, **kwargs)
+
+
+def _tilt_protocol(angle_deg: float) -> list[ProtocolSegment]:
+    return [
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=0.0, label="supine"),
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=TILT_START,
+            end=TILT_END,
+            tilt_angle_deg=angle_deg,
+            transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+            label=f"tilt-{angle_deg:g}",
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+def _sustained_hr_rise(result) -> float:
+    t = result.time
+    hr = result.outputs["heart_rate"]
+    baseline = float(hr[t <= TILT_START - 2.0].mean())
+    late = (t >= TILT_END - 120.0) & (t <= TILT_END)
+    return float(hr[late].mean() - baseline)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------- posture resolution
+def test_no_posture_field_means_supine():
+    segment = ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0)
+    assert segment.upright is None and segment.tilt_angle_deg is None
+    assert segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg() == 0.0
+    result = _simulate([ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=20.0, label="rest")])
+    assert np.all(result.outputs["tilt_angle_deg"] == 0.0)
+    assert np.all(result.outputs["upright"] == 0.0)
+
+
+def test_upright_and_tilt_angle_are_mutually_exclusive():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="only one of upright or tilt_angle_deg"):
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, upright=0.5, tilt_angle_deg=30.0).validate()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("angle", [-1.0, 90.5, 120.0])
+def test_tilt_angle_outside_0_90_rejected(angle):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="tilt_angle_deg"):
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, tilt_angle_deg=angle).validate()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("upright", [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0])
+def test_legacy_upright_maps_to_arcsin(upright):
+    segment = ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, upright=upright)
+    assert segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg() == pytest.approx(
+        math.degrees(math.asin(upright)), rel=1e-12
+    )
+    # upright=1.0 is exactly the 90 degree vertical posture.
+    if upright == 1.0:
+        assert segment.resolved_tilt_angle_deg() == pytest.approx(90.0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("upright", [0.25, 0.5, 1.0])
+def test_legacy_upright_and_explicit_tilt_produce_identical_trajectories(upright):
+    """Legacy ``upright`` is exactly ``arcsin`` sugar for ``tilt_angle_deg``."""
+    legacy = _simulate(
+        [
+            ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START),
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=TILT_START,
+                end=TILT_END,
+                upright=upright,
+                transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+    explicit = _simulate(
+        [
+            ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START),
+            ProtocolSegment(
+                start=TILT_START,
+                end=TILT_END,
+                tilt_angle_deg=math.degrees(math.asin(upright)),
+                transition_duration=TRANSITION,
+            ),
+        ]
+    )
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(legacy.states, explicit.states)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(legacy.outputs["heart_rate"], explicit.outputs["heart_rate"])
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+        legacy.outputs["tilt_angle_deg"], explicit.outputs["tilt_angle_deg"]
+    )
+
+
+def test_upright_output_is_the_vertical_sine():
+    result = _simulate(_tilt_protocol(60.0))
+    angle = np.deg2rad(result.outputs["tilt_angle_deg"])
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(result.outputs["upright"], np.sin(angle), atol=1e-12)
+
+
+def test_summary_detects_upright_via_either_posture_field():
+    for kwargs in ({"upright": 1.0}, {"tilt_angle_deg": 70.0}):
+        result = _simulate(
+            [
+                ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START),
+                ProtocolSegment(start=TILT_START, end=TILT_END, **kwargs),
+            ]
+        )
+        summary = result.summary()
+        assert "orthostatic_heart_rate_rise_bpm" in summary
+        assert "orthostatic_heart_rate_sustained_rise_bpm" in summary
+
+
+def test_summary_treats_active_stand_and_quiet_standing_as_one_bout():
+    """An active-stand transition segment followed by a quiet-standing segment
+    at the same angle is one continuous orthostatic bout: the sustained window
+    extends to the end of the quiet-standing segment, not the first segment."""
+    protocol = [
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=0.0, label="supine"),
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=120.0,
+            end=130.0,
+            tilt_angle_deg=90.0,
+            transition_duration=3.0,
+            rhythmic_muscle_activity=0.25,
+            sustained_muscle_contraction=0.25,
+            label="active-stand-transition",
+        ),
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=130.0, end=600.0, tilt_angle_deg=90.0, label="sustained-quiet-standing"
+        ),
+    ]
+    result = _simulate(protocol)
+    summary = result.summary()
+    t = result.time
+    hr = result.outputs["heart_rate"]
+    baseline = float(hr[(t >= 0.0) & (t <= 119.0)].mean())
+    # The sustained window is the final 120 s of the whole bout ([480, 600]),
+    # which only exists if the bout spans both upright segments.
+    expected_sustained = float(hr[(t >= 480.0) & (t <= 600.0)].mean() - baseline)
+    assert summary["orthostatic_heart_rate_sustained_rise_bpm"] == pytest.approx(
+        expected_sustained
+    )
+    expected_peak = float(hr[(t >= 120.0) & (t <= 420.0)].max() - baseline)
+    assert summary["orthostatic_heart_rate_rise_bpm"] == pytest.approx(expected_peak)
+
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------- transitions
+def test_transition_duration_must_fit_inside_segment():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="transition_duration"):
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, transition_duration=-1.0).validate()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="transition_duration"):
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, transition_duration=10.5).validate()
+    # Equal to the segment duration is allowed.
+    ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0, transition_duration=10.0).validate()
+
+
+def test_angle_interpolates_linearly_from_prior_segment_angle():
+    patient = _patient()
+    protocol = [
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=30.0, label="tilt-30"),
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=TILT_START,
+            end=TILT_END,
+            tilt_angle_deg=70.0,
+            transition_duration=40.0,
+            label="tilt-70",
+        ),
+    ]
+    inputs_mid = patient._inputs(TILT_START + 20.0, protocol, 40.0)
+    assert inputs_mid.tilt_angle_deg == pytest.approx(50.0)  # halfway 30 -> 70
+    inputs_end_transition = patient._inputs(TILT_START + 40.0, protocol, 40.0)
+    assert inputs_end_transition.tilt_angle_deg == pytest.approx(70.0)
+    inputs_late = patient._inputs(TILT_END - 1.0, protocol, 40.0)
+    assert inputs_late.tilt_angle_deg == pytest.approx(70.0)
+
+
+def test_first_segment_transition_interpolates_from_supine():
+    patient = _patient()
+    protocol = [
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=0.0, end=100.0, tilt_angle_deg=60.0, transition_duration=20.0
+        )
+    ]
+    assert patient._inputs(10.0, protocol, 40.0).tilt_angle_deg == pytest.approx(30.0)
+
+
+def test_transition_interpolates_only_the_angle():
+    """Non-posture inputs remain piecewise constant during a transition."""
+    patient = _patient()
+    protocol = [
+        ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=TILT_START, tilt_angle_deg=0.0, exertion=0.0),
+        ProtocolSegment(
+            start=TILT_START,
+            end=TILT_END,
+            tilt_angle_deg=60.0,
+            transition_duration=40.0,
+            exertion=1.0,
+            rhythmic_muscle_activity=1.0,
+            end_tidal_co2_mmHg=30.0,
+        ),
+    ]
+    before = patient._inputs(TILT_START - 1.0, protocol, 40.0)
+    mid = patient._inputs(TILT_START + 20.0, protocol, 40.0)  # mid-transition
+    assert mid.tilt_angle_deg == pytest.approx(30.0)
+    # Exertion, muscle activity and ETCO2 step at the boundary; they are not
+    # interpolated over the transition window.
+    assert before.exertion == 0.0
+    assert mid.exertion == 1.0
+    assert mid.rhythmic_muscle_activity == 1.0
+    assert mid.end_tidal_co2_mmHg == 30.0
+
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------- graded tilt
+def test_graded_tilt_response_increases_monotonically_with_angle():
+    """Larger tilt angles produce strictly larger sustained HR rises and
+    strictly more caudal (splanchnic + lower-limb) venous pooling."""
+    from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared.model import STATE_NAMES
+
+    rises = []
+    pooling = []
+    splanchnic = STATE_NAMES.index("splanchnic_venous_volume")
+    lower_limb = STATE_NAMES.index("lower_limb_venous_volume")
+    for angle in (30.0, 45.0, 60.0, 70.0):
+        result = _simulate(_tilt_protocol(angle))
+        rises.append(_sustained_hr_rise(result))
+        t = result.time
+        supine = t <= TILT_START - 2.0
+        late = t >= TILT_END - 120.0
+        caudal = result.states[splanchnic : lower_limb + 1]
+        pooling.append(
+            float(caudal[:, late].mean(axis=1).sum() - caudal[:, supine].mean(axis=1).sum())
+        )
+    assert all(b > a for a, b in zip(rises, rises[1:], strict=False)), rises
+    assert all(b > a for a, b in zip(pooling, pooling[1:], strict=False)), pooling
+

+def test_gapped_protocol_is_rejected_before_integration():

+                ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0),
+                ProtocolSegment(start=11.0, end=20.0),
+            ]
+        )

 ## Interpretation limits
 
 - hEDS lower-limb venous compliance includes the healthy reference value and exploratory changes; it is not a measured hEDS coefficient.
 - ME/CFS delay and onset constants are phenomenological and are not probability distributions over patients.
+- CO2 reactivity, clipping, and cerebral-outflow scenarios vary explicit computational assumptions; they do not identify patient-specific reactivity or convert ETCO2 into PaCO2.
 - Configuration hashes and solver settings are retained in JSON; no random seed is used because no stochastic sampling occurs.
 - Sensitivity does not validate equation structure or clinical utility.
